svg.text: the Phase 1 core — one SQLite file, and the two things deliberately outside it
game_uid merge hint, INDEXED not unique
Vault — NOT in the library file
never backed up with the library, never synced
XDG cache — NOT in the library file
disposable, refetchable, OS may delete it
keeps the backed-up file small enough to back up
effective_status is NOT stored — it is derived on read: status_manual ?? derive(playtime_minutes, capabilities).
KEY violet = the game row and its sync bookkeeping · grey = local-only, never syncs · red = deliberately OUTSIDE the library file
The Phase 1 schema. One SQLite file the player can back up, move or delete. Credentials and cover-art blobs are deliberately outside it - see the two boxes below the file.
